notes.title: Day Past Due
notes.body:
Trong bảng FT_LOAN, 1 KH ~ n Loan, mỗi Loan-Contract có các fields như sau:
- CNT_DAYS_PAST_DUE_CURRENT: current DPD for current contract; có thể bằng NULL khi KH hiện tại đã thanh toán, k nợ quá hạn nữa
- CNT_DAYS_PAST_DUE_MAX: max DPD từng ghi nhận trên loan-contract này; chỉ bằng 0 khi KH chưa từng nợ quá hạn
- CNT_DAYS_PAST_DUE_SUM: sum của DPD từng ghi nhận trên loan-contract này; chỉ bằng 0 khi KH chưa từng nợ quá hạn

Từ các field trên, các field  trong bảng FT_CLIENT_PART_STATIC tức level client (có thể) được aggregate như sau:
- CNT_DAYS_PAST_DUE_TOLERANCE: Max của field CNT_DAYS_PAST_DUE_CURRENT của các contract cùng 1 KH (trạng thái active hay paidoff/writen off/close gì thì vẫn tính)
- CNT_DAYS_PAST_DUE_TOL_CUR_MAX: Max của field CNT_DAYS_PAST_DUE_MAX của các ACTIVE contract cùng 1 KH; bằng 0 khi KH hiện không có active contract
- CNT_DAYS_PAST_DUE_TOL_MAX: Max của field CNT_DAYS_PAST_DUE_MAX của all contract cùng 1 KH
- CNT_DAYS_PAST_DUE_TOL_SUM: Sum của field CNT_DAYS_PAST_DUE_SUM của các contract cùng 1 KH

notes.title: Get client latest contract active
notes.body: find the latest contract (active, HCVN) per client
notes.code:
PROC SQL;
create table get_client_contract_active as
select  t1.ID_CUID
	, t1.CODE_CREDIT_TYPE
	, t1.CODE_PRODUCT
	, t1.CODE_CREDIT_STATUS	
	, t1.SKP_CREDIT_CASE
	, t1.TEXT_CONTRACT_NUMBER
	, t1.DATE_CONTRACT_SIGNATURE
	, t1.CODE_CREDIT_OWNER
	, t1.NAME_DISBURSMENT_CHANNEL_TYPE
	, intck('day', datepart(t1.DATE_CONTRACT_SIGNATURE), today()) as days_diff
from SDM.FT_CONTRACT t1
inner join SDM.FT_CLIENT_PART_STATIC t3
on t1.ID_CUID = t3.ID_CUID
inner join (
	/*find the latest contract (active, HCVN) per client*/
    select ID_CUID,
           max(DATE_CONTRACT_SIGNATURE) as Max_Contract_Date
    from SDM.FT_CONTRACT
    where CODE_CREDIT_STATUS = 'A'
      and CODE_CREDIT_OWNER = 'HCVN'
    group by ID_CUID
) t2
on t1.ID_CUID = t2.ID_CUID
and t1.DATE_CONTRACT_SIGNATURE = t2.Max_Contract_Date

where t1.CODE_CREDIT_STATUS ='A'
and t1.CODE_CREDIT_OWNER = 'HCVN'
and (t3.CNT_DAYS_PAST_DUE_TOLERANCE = 0
or t3.CNT_DAYS_PAST_DUE_TOLERANCE is null)
and (
    (t2.Max_Contract_Date >= Today()-20 and t2.Max_Contract_Date < Today()-19)
 or (t2.Max_Contract_Date >= Today()-25 and t2.Max_Contract_Date < Today()-24)
)
;QUIT;

notes.title: Get active card contract
notes.body: Clients have ACTIVE credit card contract - active card - card segment filter
notes.code:
PROC SQL;
/*Clients have ACTIVE credit card contract*/
create table get_client_contract_active as
select  t1.ID_CUID, t1.SKP_CLIENT
	, t1.SKP_CREDIT_CASE
	, t1.CODE_CREDIT_TYPE
	, t1.CODE_CREDIT_STATUS	
	, t1.CODE_PRODUCT
/*	, t1.TEXT_CONTRACT_NUMBER*/
from SDM.FT_CONTRACT t1
where CODE_CREDIT_TYPE ='REV' /*credit card contract*/
and CODE_CREDIT_STATUS='A'  /*active contract*/
and CODE_PRODUCT not in ('ATM_MC_45','ATM_U_INST','BHX_CCW_01','REVMC0_49')  
and CODE_PRODUCT not like '%BNPL%'
and CODE_PRODUCT not like '%CC_CD%'
and CODE_PRODUCT not like '%CCCD%'
and CODE_PRODUCT in ('BEE_CCW_01', 'CCX_01', 'CCX_U_INST', 'CCX_U_MC', 'CCX_VOC_PI_INST', 'CCXMC_01', 
	'MAX_AC_NSA', 'MAX_MC_29', 'MAX_MC_38', 'MAX_MC_49', 'MAX_XS_01', 'MAX_XS_29', 'MAX_XS_38', 'MAX_XS_49', 
	'TOP_U_INST', 'TOP_U_MC', 'XSTU_49', 'XSTU_MC_49', 'CCW_U_INST', 'CCW_U_MC', 
	'SCW_00_45', 'SCW_00_49', 'SCW_N12_49', 'SCX_00_45')
;QUIT;


PROC SQL;
/* Clients 1 active card status
	& credit card available limit >= 3.000.000VND*/
create table get_client_active_card as
select t0.ID_CUID, t1.SKP_CLIENT, t0.TEXT_CONTRACT_NUMBER,
	t0.SKP_CREDIT_CASE, t0.CODE_CREDIT_STATUS,
	t0.CODE_PRODUCT, t1.CODE_CARD_STATUS,
	t1.AMT_DISPOSABLE
from get_client_contract_active t0
inner join SDM.FT_CREDIT_CARD t1
on t0.SKP_CREDIT_CASE = t1.SKP_CREDIT_CASE
where 1=1
and t1.AMT_DISPOSABLE >= 3000000
and t1.CODE_CARD_STATUS = 'A'
group by t0.ID_CUID, t0.SKP_CREDIT_CASE, t0.CODE_PRODUCT, t1.AMT_DISPOSABLE 
;QUIT;


PROC SQL;
/* Clients are in the 'INACTIVE' segment*/
create table get_client_inactive_seg as
select  t0.*,
	  t1.TEXT_CON_SEGMENTATION
from get_client_active_card t0
left join SDM.FT_CARD_SEGMENT_PARAM_PM t1
  on (t0.SKP_CREDIT_CASE=t1.SKP_CREDIT_CASE)
where t1.TEXT_CON_SEGMENTATION = '2-Inactive'
;QUIT;

notes.title: Call Policy
notes.code:
proc sql;												
create table work.call_policy as											
select distinct a.id_cuid										
from sdm.ft_client_part_static a									
inner join sdm.ft_client_contact b								
on a.id_cuid = b.id_cuid							
where								
flag_call_refused = 'N'							
and flag_valid_document = 'Y'							
and flag_pdp_consent = 'Y'							
and name_phone_mobile_prim_status = 'Valid'
and a.id_cuid not in (
	select distinct id_cuid							
	from int.cm_blacklist 							
	where blacklist_status = 'ACTIVE' 
	and blacklist_channel = 'TLS'
	)						
and a.id_cuid not in (						
	SELECT distinct id_cuid						
	FROM INT.CM_BLACKLIST_CLIENT 						
	WHERE BLACKLIST_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'						
	AND BLACKLIST_SOURCE = 'AIS'					
	AND (CREATED_DTTM >= today() - 1 
	or	UPDATED_DTTM >= today() - 1
	)				
)												
;quit;

notes.title: Import to IL_IMPORT - Not Exists
notes.code:
proc sql;
insert
	into int.il_import
		(
			id_cuid,
			import_name,
			import_date,
			num_param1,
			num_param2,
			num_param3,
			num_param4,
			char_param1,
			char_param2,
			char_param3,
			char_param4,
			date_param1,
			date_param2

		)
select  id_cuid,
		'EPP_CARD_T2_RECOVER' as import_name,
		datetime() format=datetime20. as import_date,
		skp_credit_case as num_param1,
		skf_card_transaction_ad as num_param2,
		amt_transaction as num_param3,
		tenor as num_param4,
		text_contract_number as char_param1,
		segment_cal as char_param2,
		code_product as char_param3,
		code_transaction_type as char_param4,
		date_presentment as date_param1,
		date_transaction as date_param2
	from work.highest_elgi_trx_t2 new
where not exists 
	( 
		SELECT CUR.ID_CUID
		FROM INT.IL_IMPORT CUR
		WHERE CUR.IMPORT_NAME = 'EPP_CARD_T2_RECOVER'
		AND CUR.ID_CUID = NEW.ID_CUID
		AND CUR.num_param1 = NEW.skp_credit_case
		AND IMPORT_DATE>=today()
	);
quit;
